method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that the triangle is right-angled, with legs labeled 12 ft and 9 ft. Use the right-triangle relationship to compute the slanted side: sqrt(12^2 + 9^2) = sqrt(144 + 81) = sqrt(225) = 15 ft, matching the image label. Then add the three side lengths for the perimeter: 12 + 9 + 15 = 36.
